findings.description: Re-raising the cause with `from None` sets `__suppress_context__` and `__cause__` to None on the underlying exception, erasing its own exception chain (e.g. an original cause it was raised from).
findings.rationale: Trigger: the cause exception was itself raised `from` another exception, or has its own context, and TryAgain wraps it. `raise cause from None` overwrites `cause.__cause__` with None and sets `__suppress_context__ = True`, so the original chain is lost from the traceback. The user sees a truncated traceback and loses debugging information. Also, `cause.with_traceback(cause.__traceback__)` is a no-op.
